description: House defaults applied to every board by scripts/apply_house_standards.py unless a board overrides them.

speech.note: Pin one installed voice by name (e.g. 'Microsoft Catherine' on Windows, 'Karen' on iPad) after choosing it with the student. preferLocal keeps boards working offline: Edge 'Online (Natural)' voices need internet.

meaning.question: purple: questions
meaning.important: red: negation, stop and emergency words
meaning.operation: light grey-blue: board operations (speak, undo, pages)

cvi.note: Dark background, no word-class colour, one bright highlight colour (use the student's preferred colour), wider spacing, symbols on a plain plate. Set target count, dwell time and symbol type with the vision/CVI team.

coreWords.note: 'don't' rather than 'not' by default so partners model 'I don't like it', not 'I not like'. Swap words to suit the student; the page holds six.

promptLadder: Model the word yourself on the board while you talk. Don't ask the student to copy you.
Wait with an expectant look: count the wait time in your head.
Comment on what is happening, then wait again.
Ask an open question, then wait.
Point near the part of the board (not the button), then wait.
Never move the student's hand or body to the board (no hand-over-hand).

evidenceLog.consentNote: Off by default. Turn on only after the team and family agree, and only for the purpose in the evidence plan. Logs stay on this device in memory until exported.
